Implemented the Rust port as a Cargo project in [/output/Cargo.toml](/output/Cargo.toml) with the root entrypoint at [/output/test5.rs](/output/test5.rs). The logic is split into [/output/src/cli.rs](/output/src/cli.rs), [/output/src/hopscotch_map.rs](/output/src/hopscotch_map.rs), [/output/src/program.rs](/output/src/program.rs), and [/output/src/lib.rs](/output/src/lib.rs). It uses only `std`, Rust 2021, and matches the C++ behavior including `--a` parsing, default count, `std::stoi`-style prefix parsing, and the final `size removed\n` output.

I built both binaries successfully: `/output/test5` via `rustc --edition 2021 test5.rs -o test5` and `/output/target/release/test5` via `cargo build --release`. I also verified the outputs against `/workspace/dataset/test5_executable` for the provided examples plus edge cases like `foo`, `--a 2junk`, `--a junk`, and missing `--a` count.
